sources: Spin-loft table of the impact model (#15443 F2): centred strike, zero attack angle (spin loft = face loft), ball at rest, ball friction coefficient 0.4 and COR 0.83 as ImpactParameters defaults. model_backspin_rpm is the RigidBodyImpactModel output at the commit that added this fixture (regression values); the test also checks it against the closed-form oblique-impact solution of Cross, R., 'Grip-slip behavior of a bouncing ball', Am. J. Phys. 70(11), 1093-1101 (2002) and Penner, A. R., 'The physics of golf', Rep. Prog. Phys. 66, 131-171 (2003): tangential impulse = min(mu*J_n, v_t/(1/m_ball+1/M_club+R^2/I_ball)), spin = R*J_t/I_ball. Real-world context only (not asserted): TrackMan PGA Tour averages, driver 113 mph club / 167 mph ball / 2686 rpm, 7-iron 7097 rpm (TrackMan 'Tour Averages', trackman.com). TrackMan does not publish tour spin loft, so no pass/fail comparison is made. Head masses: driver 0.200 kg pipeline default, 7-iron 0.268 kg from club_models via club_impact_for; head inertia does not enter a centred strike.
